name: Horbury
blurb: Ten minutes from Horbury. Plenty of Horbury customers prefer the quieter home setting over a busy high-street salon.
metaDescription: Dog grooming near Horbury — a 10-minute drive to Keith's K9 Care in Hall Green, Wakefield WF4. A calmer alternative to a busy high-street salon. Book.
lead: Ten minutes from Horbury, Keith's K9 Care is a calm, one-to-one home dog grooming salon — the quieter alternative for owners who'd rather skip a busy high-street salon.
body: Horbury has plenty going on along the high street, but a busy commercial salon isn't to every dog's taste. For owners who'd rather their dog wasn't one of several in a noisy unit, we're about ten minutes away in Hall Green — a home salon where your dog is the only one in the room.

That's the whole idea behind Keith's K9 Care: one dog at a time, in a quiet, purpose-built space, with no kennels, no shared dryers and no other dogs barking through the wall. It's a calmer experience that nervous dogs, rescue dogs, puppies and older dogs genuinely do better in — and it means Keith works at your dog's pace rather than the clock's.

Keith is IPET-qualified and grooms every coat type — full grooms, puppy first grooms, bath and tidy, nail trims, de-matting and traditional hand stripping. Prices are published in full with breed examples (no ringing round for a quote), and confirmed in person before he starts.
If your Horbury dog would prefer a calmer groom, booking in is a quick call, WhatsApp or message. Keith likes a quick chat about coat, age and temperament first so the right time is set aside.

faqs.q: How far is the salon from Horbury?
faqs.a: About 3.5 miles — a ten-minute drive to Castle Meadows in Hall Green (WF4).

faqs.q: Why come to you rather than a Horbury high-street salon?
faqs.a: For the calm. We're a one-dog-at-a-time home salon — no queue, no other dogs, no rush — which suits nervous, rescue and older dogs especially. Prices are published and Keith does every dog himself.
Often — the quiet, predictable home setup is ideal for a rescue who's still building confidence. Tell Keith the background when you book and he'll take it gently.
